violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SALSA AT 48F AND SALSA VERDE AT 48F IN 1-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER (SERVICE LINE AREA); OBSERVED SLICED TOMATOES AT 48F, SHREDDED LETTUCE AT 47F, GRILLED CHICKEN AT 52F, SLICED TOMATOES AT 45F, AND SPINACH AT 50F IN THE THREE-DOOR PREP TOP; OBSERVED YOGURT CUPS AT 50F, STRING CHEESE AT 56F, AND MILK AT 53F IN THE DISPLAY COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED FOOD ITEMS DURING THE INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD ALWAYS BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE THESE COOLERS ARE NOT USED UNTIL THEY CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED 1-DOOR UPRIGHT (SERVICE LINE AREA) AT 47F, THREE-DOOR PREP TOP AT 46F, AND THE DISPLAY CASE AT 60F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED TCS FOOD ITEMS FROM THESE COOLERS DURING THE INSPECTION AND CALLED THE MAINTENANCE TEAM TO REPAIR THESE COOLERS. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE COOLERS SHOULD NOT BE USED FOR TCS FOODS UNTIL THEY HAVE BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution.

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED THREE-VAT SINK MEET A MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 109F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PIC PLACED WORK ORDER FOR THREE-VAT SINK TEMPERATURE DURING INSPECTION.
